Silvia S13 / Civic EK9 — Relight Lab

Isometric sprite rendered from the 3D model with flat colour, normal, depth and specular maps. Move the light in the grid space and check whether the car takes light the way a car should. Orthographic 2:1 pixel isometric: 30° elevation, 45° azimuth, 128 px sprites at a shared 26 px/m scale. Windows are opaque dark grey; license plates are plain white.

Drag on the stage to move the light across the ground at the current height. Left and right views are mirrors, so the mirror switch gives the other two headings from the same maps.

Wheel spin

Shake and wheel spin follow the highway speed. Wheels use 8 pre-rendered spin frames plus a blurred set. Lights glow from an emission map.

Highway mode

The car stays put and the road scrolls under it along the car's heading. Lamps use the Height, Reach, Intensity and Colour settings below. Offset 0 puts them over the lane; the front/back and mirror switches change the heading.
